apiKey.label: Coda API Key
apiKey.description: Create an API key in the Coda Account dashboard (https://coda.io/account).

get_current_user.label: Get Current User
get_current_user.description: Returns the Coda account and workspace that the connected API token belongs to.

get_doc.label: Get Doc
get_doc.description: Gets the details of a doc: name, owner, links, folder, workspace and size.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

get_page.label: Get Page
get_page.description: Gets a page's details: name, subtitle, parent, subpages, visibility and links.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

pageIdOrName.label: Page ID or Name
pageIdOrName.description: The page ID (starts with "canvas-") or its exact name. Use List Pages to find it.

get_formula.label: Get Named Formula
get_formula.description: Gets the current value of a named formula.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

formulaIdOrName.label: Formula ID or Name
formulaIdOrName.description: The formula ID (starts with "f-") or its exact name.

get_control.label: Get Control
get_control.description: Gets the type and current value of a control.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

controlIdOrName.label: Control ID or Name
controlIdOrName.description: The control ID (starts with "ctrl-") or its exact name.

get-table.label: Get Table
get-table.description: Get the details of a specific table: name, type, row count, display column and layout.

docId.label: Document
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-"). Use List Tables to find it.

get-row.label: Get Row
get-row.description: Retrieves a single row by specified ID.

docId.label: Document
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-"). Use List Tables to find it.

create-row.label: Create Row
create-row.description: Creates a new row in the specified table.

docId.label: Document
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-"). Use List Tables to find it.

rowData.label: Row Data
rowData.description: The values as a JSON object keyed by column ID or name, for example {"c-Col1": "Write spec"}. Use List Columns to find the IDs.

update-row.label: Update Row
update-row.description: Updates an existing row in the specified table.

docId.label: Document
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-"). Use List Tables to find it.

rowIdOrName.label: Row ID or Name
rowIdOrName.description: The row ID (starts with "i-") or the value of its display column.

rowData.label: Row Data
rowData.description: The values as a JSON object keyed by column ID or name, for example {"c-Col1": "Write spec"}. Use List Columns to find the IDs.

update-row.afterResponse:
if (response.id == null) throw new Error('Unexpected error occured : ' + JSON.stringify(response));
return {rowId: response.id, requestId: response.requestId};

upsert-row.label: Upsert Row
upsert-row.description: Creates a new row or updates an existing one if the row is found by the matching columns.

docId.label: Document
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableId.label: Table
tableId.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-"). Use List Tables to find it.

keyColumns.label: Matching Columns
keyColumns.description: The column IDs that find an existing row, as a JSON list such as ["c-Col1"]. Each needs a value in Row Data.

rowData.label: Row Data
rowData.description: The values as a JSON object keyed by column ID or name, for example {"c-Col1": "Write spec"}. Use List Columns to find the IDs.

upsert-row.afterResponse:
if (!response.requestId) throw new Error('Unexpected error occured : ' + JSON.stringify(response));
return {success: true, requestId: response.requestId};

get_table_by_id.label: Get Table (by ID)
get_table_by_id.description: Gets a table's details by doc ID and table ID or name.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableIdOrName.label: Table ID or Name
tableIdOrName.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-") or its exact name. IDs are safer: names can change or repeat. Use List Tables to find it.

get_row_by_id.label: Get Row (by ID)
get_row_by_id.description: Gets one row by doc ID, table ID and row ID.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

tableIdOrName.label: Table ID or Name
tableIdOrName.description: The table ID (starts with "grid-" or "table-") or its exact name. IDs are safer: names can change or repeat. Use List Tables to find it.

rowIdOrName.label: Row ID
rowIdOrName.description: The row ID (starts with "i-"), for example from List Rows. A display-column value also works, but if several rows share it Coda picks one at random.

list_docs.label: List Docs
list_docs.description: Lists the docs the connected account can open, one page at a time, with optional search and filters.

query.label: Search
query.description: Only docs whose name contains this text.

folderId.label: Folder ID
folderId.description: Only docs in this folder (starts with "fl-"). Use List Folders to find it.

workspaceId.label: Workspace ID
workspaceId.description: Only docs in this workspace (starts with "ws-").

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: How many items to return in this page (1-100).

pageToken.label: Page Token
pageToken.description: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass the Next Page Token from the previous result.

list_docs.afterResponse:
var token = response.nextPageToken ?? null;
return {items: response.items ?? [], nextPageToken: token, hasMore: token !== null};

filterColumn.label: Filter Column
filterColumn.description: Optional column ID or name. Only rows where this column equals Filter Value are returned.

filterValue.label: Filter Value
filterValue.description: The value the Filter Column must equal. Required when Filter Column is set.

useColumnNames.label: Key Values by Column Name
useColumnNames.description: When off, values are keyed by column ID, which does not change if a column is renamed.

get_mutation_status.label: Get Mutation Status
get_mutation_status.description: Checks whether an earlier change (by its Request ID) has been applied by Coda.

requestId.label: Request ID
requestId.description: The Request ID returned by a previous Coda step.

get_mutation_status.afterResponse: return {requestId: inputs.requestId.trim(), completed: response.completed, warning: response.warning ?? null};

update_doc.label: Rename Doc
update_doc.description: Changes a doc's title and/or icon.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

iconName.label: Icon Name
iconName.description: A Coda icon name, for example "rocket".

trigger_automation.label: Trigger Automation
trigger_automation.description: Runs a doc automation whose trigger is "Webhook invoked", optionally passing a JSON payload.

docId.label: Doc ID or Link
docId.description: The doc ID, for example AbC123xyZ. Use List Docs to find it.

ruleId.label: Automation Rule ID
ruleId.description: In the doc, open Automations, pick the rule with the "Webhook invoked" trigger, and copy its rule ID (it looks like grid-auto-xxxx).

payload.label: Payload
payload.description: Optional JSON object the automation can read as its webhook payload.

resolve_browser_link.label: Resolve Coda Link
resolve_browser_link.description: Finds the doc, page, table or row a Coda link points to and returns its IDs.

url.label: Link
url.description: A coda.io or docs.superhuman.com link copied from the browser.

new-row-created.label: New Row Created
new-row-created.description: Triggers when a new row is added to the selected table.
